descriptions.Drunurnar Mountains: An ice-capped range fills the western Land.
descriptions.Krokskogur Forest: Dwarf pine covers the valley below the mountains.
descriptions.Lake Hornindal: A great cold lake fills the basin. Ice remains in its coves and along its northern shore through the short summer.
descriptions.Bjorgheim: A walled stone city stands where the mountain roads meet.
descriptions.Roros: A remote stone town guards the northern pass. Snow lies against its walls through most of the year.
descriptions.Svalaver: A stone fishing town stands on the southern shore. Dwarf and human merchants meet beside its jetty.

firascir.name: Firascir
firascir.description: A broad human kingdom lies between the northern mountains and the western sea. Two great rivers cross its fields.

descriptions.Firascir: A broad human kingdom lies between the northern mountains and the western sea. Two great rivers cross its fields.
descriptions.Whitweld Forest: Pale beech trunks fill the old wood east of the fields.
descriptions.Grendon Fields: Farms, hedged roads, and sheep pastures cover the rising ground below the northern mountains.
descriptions.Stura River: A great river runs from the northern mountains through Grendon Fields. It continues south through Mortellaria and reaches the sea.
descriptions.Flumenpur River: A great river runs from the northern mountains through Tomburgh. It continues east-southeast through Caelum toward Tergal.
descriptions.Tomburgh: The walled capital stands on both banks of the Flumenpur River. The great east road crosses the river here.
descriptions.Leehaven: A harbor city stands around a sheltered bay on the northwestern coast. Fishing boats crowd its inner quay.
descriptions.Walhaven: A walled harbor city guards the southwestern coast road. Human and foreign merchants unload beside its stone docks.
descriptions.Bradwhitchip: A market town stands among the farms of Grendon Fields. Grain carts fill its square after harvest.
descriptions.Redflurton: A riverside town stands where the old road meets the lower Flumenpur River. Reed beds line the water below its bridge.
descriptions.Sturford: A farming village stands beside a shallow crossing of the Stura River.
descriptions.Ackham: A village of small farms stands at the western edge of Whitweld Forest.
descriptions.Flurham: A fishing village stands beside a broad pond fed by the Flumenpur River.

mortellaria.name: Mortellaria
mortellaria.description: A warm human kingdom lies between dry hills and the western sea. Vineyards, olive groves, and old stone roads cover the settled country.

descriptions.Mortellaria: A warm human kingdom lies between dry hills and the western sea. Vineyards, olive groves, and old stone roads cover the settled country.
descriptions.Valdoro Hills: Terraced vineyards and olive groves cover the hills south of Castavera. Stone walls divide the slopes.
descriptions.Orivela Coast: A rocky coast runs west of the capital. Pines grow above its coves and sea caves.
descriptions.Pinavera Valley: A dry pine valley cuts through the southern uplands. Goat tracks cross its stony slopes.
descriptions.Riomara Plain: Farms and irrigation channels cover the low plain east of the hills. The Stura River bends through its fields.
descriptions.Stura River: The great river continues south from Firascir. It crosses Riomara Plain and reaches the western sea.
descriptions.Castavera: The walled capital stands above the Stura River road. White stone halls and tiled roofs surround its market.
descriptions.Portomera: A harbor city fills a deep cove on the Orivela Coast. Stone quays shelter fishing boats and merchant ships.
descriptions.Belafonte: A market town stands among the lower Valdoro Hills. A public fountain fills the square below its olive presses.
descriptions.Montaro: A stone town climbs a steep vineyard hill. Its upper gate overlooks the road through Pinavera Valley.
descriptions.Vineyard village: A small village stands among vineyards and olive terraces. Wine carts wait beside its press house.
descriptions.River-plain village: A farming village stands beside an irrigation channel on Riomara Plain. Reeds grow along its low walls.
descriptions.Coast-road village: A fishing village stands where the coast road descends to a sheltered cove.

village_descriptions.vineyard_village: A small village stands among vineyards and olive terraces. Wine carts wait beside its press house.
village_descriptions.river_plain_village: A farming village stands beside an irrigation channel on Riomara Plain. Reeds grow along its low walls.
village_descriptions.coast_road_village: A fishing village stands where the coast road descends to a sheltered cove.

ensimaa.name: Ensimaa
ensimaa.description: An elven realm fills the great eastern forest. Rivers, old roads, and small settlements run beneath its canopy.

descriptions.Ensimaa: An elven realm fills the great eastern forest. Rivers, old roads, and small settlements run beneath its canopy.
descriptions.Tiravaine Forest: Great oaks and beeches fill the center of Ensimaa. Raised paths cross the roots beneath the oldest trees.
descriptions.Koivelle Wood: Birch and pale beech cover the western wood. Old boundary stones stand beside its roads.
descriptions.Maelmor Hills: Wooded hills rise along the northern border. Bare ridges break through the trees above the high pastures.
descriptions.Avelune River: A clear river runs south through the forest. Root bridges and ferry paths join its banks.
descriptions.Saimere Hollow: Low woodland surrounds a chain of clear pools. Mist remains between the trees until midday.
descriptions.Taivelle: The elven capital stands among great living trees beside the Avelune River. Timber halls and stone walks circle an open market.
descriptions.Dunmaelle: A timber town guards the western forest road. Its gate stands between two old beeches.
descriptions.Kervaine: A river town stands on both banks of the Avelune. Boats tie beneath its broad wooden bridge.
descriptions.Ruunamont: A hill town stands above the northern forest. Stone terraces climb from the lower road to its watch hall.
descriptions.Deep-forest village: A small village stands in a wide clearing beneath old trees. Raised paths join its timber houses.
descriptions.River village: A fishing village stands beside a quiet bend of the Avelune River.
descriptions.Woodland-edge village: A village of foresters and small farms stands at the western edge of Koivelle Wood.

village_descriptions.deep_forest_village: A small village stands in a wide clearing beneath old trees. Raised paths join its timber houses.
village_descriptions.elf_river_village: A fishing village stands beside a quiet bend of the Avelune River.
village_descriptions.woodland_edge_village: A village of foresters and small farms stands at the western edge of Koivelle Wood.

gibili.name: Gibili
gibili.description: A goblin country spreads across a hot coast and dry inland hills. Brick roads, patched towers, and crowded yards join its settlements.

descriptions.Gibili: A goblin country spreads across a hot coast and dry inland hills. Brick roads, patched towers, and crowded yards join its settlements.
descriptions.Kapaliki Coast: A broken coast of low cliffs and narrow coves runs along western Gibili. Sea caves open below the road.
descriptions.Barasa Hills: Dry hills rise north of Maketawa. Olive scrub and abandoned quarries cover their lower slopes.
descriptions.Paina Valley: A pine valley runs south from Birikava. Charcoal tracks cross the dry forest floor.
descriptions.Wela River: A brown river crosses the settled center of Gibili. Rope ferries and reed yards line its banks.
descriptions.Satakalu Plain: Dry grass and clay flats stretch east of the capital. Brick pits mark the old road.
descriptions.Maketawa: The goblin capital crowds both sides of the Wela River. Brick halls, metal roofs, and market awnings fill the inner wall.
descriptions.Potalu: A harbor town stands around a narrow cove on the Kapaliki Coast. Piled timber jetties reach between the rocks.
descriptions.Birikava: A busy town stands where the river road meets the road to Paina Valley. Carts and repair yards fill its outer streets.
descriptions.Boilaki: A brick town stands below an old quarry in the Barasa Hills. Smoke rises from lime kilns outside its wall.
descriptions.Coast village: A fishing village fills a small cove below the Kapaliki road. Nets hang from every rail.
descriptions.River village: A reed-cutting village stands beside a rope ferry on the Wela River.
descriptions.Brick-country village: A small village stands beside clay pits on Satakalu Plain. Brick clamps smoke beyond its yards.

village_descriptions.goblin_coast_village: A fishing village fills a small cove below the Kapaliki road. Nets hang from every rail.
village_descriptions.goblin_river_village: A reed-cutting village stands beside a rope ferry on the Wela River.
village_descriptions.brick_country_village: A small village stands beside clay pits on Satakalu Plain. Brick clamps smoke beyond its yards.

tergal.name: Tergal
tergal.description: An orc realm covers the eastern prairie. Herd roads cross its grasslands between rivers, dry basins, and broken hills.

descriptions.Tergal: An orc realm covers the eastern prairie. Herd roads cross its grasslands between rivers, dry basins, and broken hills.
descriptions.Khuratal Steppe: Open grassland stretches east of Ulus-Gal. Herd trails and wagon roads run beneath the constant wind.
descriptions.Borugal Hills: Broken stone hills rise along the northern border. Narrow passes cut between their bare slopes.
descriptions.Temur Ridge: A long ridge overlooks the central prairie. Horses and sheep graze on its high slopes.
descriptions.Namak Basin: A dry basin lies south of the capital. Salt grass grows around its wells and seasonal pools.
descriptions.Kharun River: A broad river crosses the eastern prairie. Willow groves mark its bends.
descriptions.Flumenpur River: The great river enters Tergal from Caelum. The western road follows its north bank toward Kharuk.
descriptions.Ulus-Gal: The walled capital stands on a low rise above the prairie. Broad roads lead from its great hall to the horse market and eastern gate.
descriptions.Kharuk: A road town guards the Flumenpur crossing. Traders from Caelum camp outside its western wall.
descriptions.Temenur: A stone town stands below Temur Ridge. Herd pens and wool stores fill its lower quarter.
descriptions.Ordubal: A low-walled town stands beside the main well of Namak Basin. Salt and livestock caravans meet in its yard.
descriptions.Herd-road village: A herding village stands beside a well on Khuratal Steppe. Corrals surround its low houses.
descriptions.River village: A fishing and ferry village stands in a willow bend of the Kharun River.
descriptions.Basin village: A small village stands beside a deep well in Namak Basin. Salt grass and goat pens surround it.

village_descriptions.orc_river_village: A fishing and ferry village stands in a willow bend of the Kharun River.
village_descriptions.orc_basin_village: A small village stands beside a deep well in Namak Basin. Salt grass and goat pens surround it.
